sections.Profile:
The Dixieland pinball machine, released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1968, is an electro-mechanical game designed by Ted Zale with artwork by Christian Marche. This single-player machine features two flippers and is known for its colorful New Orleans-themed backglass artwork, evoking a jazz music vibe.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
